_comment: CLIs required by skills in this repo. Every entry must name a skill under skills/ in requiredBy; scripts/validate-cli-dependencies.ts enforces it.

clis.manualInstall: Install Node.js >= 22 (with npm) before running this script; it is a prerequisite, not a target. https://nodejs.org

clis._comment: pure-JS npm package (deps: graphql/commander/node-emoji, no native modules) - installs natively on every platform incl. win32-arm64; versioned with calver; `auth status` exits 0 even unauthenticated, so auth.check is a real API call

auth.instructions: Set LINEAR_API_TOKEN (headless) or run `linearis auth login` (interactive), using a personal API key from Linear Settings -> Security & access -> API -> Personal API keys. The key does not expire.

clis.manualInstall: winget install GitHub.cli | brew install gh | see https://github.com/cli/cli#installation

auth.instructions: Run `gh auth login` and complete the browser flow; its classic token carries the `repo` scope (plus `read:org` for organisation repos) that GitHub Issues as a tracker needs. A fine-grained token needs Issues, Contents and Pull requests set to read and write on the repo - Contents because `gh issue develop` creates the issue branch.

clis.manualInstall: winget install GLab.GLab | brew install glab | see https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli#installation

auth.instructions: Run `glab auth login` and complete the flow for your GitLab host. A personal access token needs the `api` scope (issues, labels, notes and `glab api`, which GitLab Issues as a tracker uses) and `write_repository` (push).

clis._comment: the GitLab Issues tracker adapter filters `glab api` output with jq, because `glab api` has no --jq flag; the Azure DevOps Boards tracker adapter builds JSON Patch bodies for `az devops invoke` and filters its output with jq
clis.manualInstall: winget install jqlang.jq | brew install jq | apt install jq

clis._comment: Azure CLI; the azure-devops extension is not a separate entry, so auth.check probes for it - signing in to a specific organisation is checked by adapters/vcs/ado.md, which knows the org
clis.manualInstall: winget install Microsoft.AzureCLI | brew install azure-cli | see https://learn.microsoft.com/cli/azure/install-azure-cli

auth.instructions: Run `az extension add --name azure-devops`, then `az login` (Microsoft Entra) or `az devops login` (personal access token). A personal access token needs Work Items (Read, write & manage), Code (Read & write) and Project and Team (Read); Azure DevOps Boards as a tracker needs team admin rights only to add board columns.

clis.manualInstall: winget install BurntSushi.ripgrep.MSVC | brew install ripgrep | apt install ripgrep
Install git before running this script; it is a prerequisite, not a target.
